copy.tagline: 自动化管理 Bitbucket 仓库、PR、分支和问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常在 Bitbucket 上处理 PR、分支和仓库管理任务
copy.tagline_en: Automate Bitbucket repositories, pull requests, branches, and issues
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently manage Bitbucket repos, PRs, and branches

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以管理 Bitbucket 仓库、拉取请求、分支、议题和工作区。它能创建、查看、更新和删除这些资源，并添加评论。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 操作 Bitbucket 仓库、拉取请求、分支、议题或工作区时触发。例如，创建拉取请求、列出议题或删除分支。

say.text: 帮我创建一个拉取请求，从 feature/login 合并到 main。
列出 workspace 'my-team' 中所有开放的议题。
say.note: Claude 会查询并返回议题列表。
Claude 会先确认再执行删除。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can manage Bitbucket repositories, pull requests, branches, issues, and workspaces. It can create, view, update, and delete these resources, and add comments.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to perform operations on Bitbucket repositories, pull requests, branches, issues, or workspaces. For example, creating a pull request, listing issues, or deleting a branch.

say_en.text: Create a pull request from feature/login to main.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to connect Bitbucket and create the PR.

say_en.text: List all open issues in workspace 'my-team'.
say_en.note: Claude will query and return the issue list.
